description: This Java source file contains an abstract test class for testing HTTP request actors within the Eclipse Ditto gateway endpoints project. It sets up an actor system, provides utility methods for testing message and attribute modification commands via HTTP requests, and manages test configurations and headers.

classes.name: AbstractHttpRequestActorTest
classes.description: An abstract class providing setup, utility methods, and test helpers for testing HTTP actors within the Eclipse Ditto gateway services. It manages an actor system, configuration, and offers methods to test attribute modifications and messaging commands over HTTP.

methods.name: beforeClass
methods.description: Initializes the actor system and gateway configuration before all tests.

methods.name: afterClass
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after all tests have run.

methods.name: testThingModifyCommand
methods.description: Tests the modification of a thing's attribute via an HTTP PUT request, verifying response status and headers.

methods.name: testMessageCommand
methods.description: Tests sending a message command to a thing, validating the HTTP response and headers.

methods.name: testMessageCommand
methods.description: Performs the actual message command test and returns the HTTP response, used internally.

methods.name: buildSendThingMessageResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response object representing the expected send message reply, including status, headers, and payload.

methods.name: createHttpRequestActor
methods.description: Creates an actor to handle the HTTP request, with given parameters.

methods.name: createAuthorizedHeaders
methods.description: Builds headers containing authorization context for testing secured endpoints.

methods.name: createExpectedWhoamiResponse
methods.description: Generates a mock HTTP response for a whoami request, with user info and headers.

methods.name: getAuthContextWithPrefixedSubjectsFromHeaders
methods.description: Extracts and constructs an AuthorizationContext object from headers.
